1Add your nodes

Supports Naive HTTPS, Hysteria2, Trojan, Shadowsocks and VLESS. One link per line, or native sing-box nodes JSON; up to 200 nodes and 1 MB.

Nodes stay in this tab. No uploads or automatic storage; refreshing clears them.

    2Choose your device

    Advanced · core, DNS and port

    Match your client core. The experimental 1.15 presets target 1.15.0-alpha.12.

    RealIP is more compatible. FakeIP requires DNS capture through a TUN / VPN mode.

    Updates DNS, TUN addresses and routing together. Requires IPv6-capable networks and exits. IPv4 is the default.

    Enables direct router and NAS access; bypassed traffic is outside proxy policies. Disable when corporate or overlay networks must enter TUN.

    Choose a DNS-over-HTTPS provider. Direct DNS bypasses the proxy; proxy DNS follows the main selection. Availability depends on your network.

    Bound to 127.0.0.1 to avoid exposing an unauthenticated proxy to the LAN.

    Usage guides

    First time here?

    1. Install an official client and check its core version.
    2. Paste your nodes, choose a device and generate.
    3. Download the JSON and import it as a local profile.

    Read the import guide ↗

    Change or add nodes

    Read your saved nodes.json, edit the nodes and generate again. Replace the client profile. Reuse the nodes file when updating default rules.

    Read the update guide ↗

    Connection trouble after import?

    Check the core version and node details first. Try RealIP for app compatibility issues. On Linux / Windows, start with local HTTP / SOCKS mode to check your nodes.

    Read troubleshooting steps ↗

    Default profile and command line

    Raw JSON is a default placeholder profile. The CLI command below includes your options and uses the same generator as this page.
